name: ardot-design-expert
description: Delivers more than mockups: token-bound UI on the Ardot canvas, production-ready frontend code, and dual-evidence pixel audits. Self-contained; runs in any MCP-capable IDE.

profession.zh: 设计出码与像素级走查专家

displayDescription.en: Not another mockup — editable design files, runnable frontend code, and evidence-backed pixel audits you can actually sign off.
displayDescription.zh: 交付的不是效果图：可编辑设计稿、可运行前端代码、有据可查的像素级走查，能直接验收。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Design a SaaS dashboard with light and dark themes, all colors bound to design tokens
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 设计一个带亮/暗双主题的 SaaS dashboard，颜色全绑成设计 token

quickPrompts.en: Design a SaaS dashboard with light and dark themes, all colors bound to design tokens
quickPrompts.zh: 设计一个带亮/暗双主题的 SaaS dashboard，颜色全绑成设计 token

quickPrompts.en: Turn this design into React + Tailwind and verify pixel-level fidelity
quickPrompts.zh: 把这份设计稿转成 React + Tailwind，并校验像素级还原度

quickPrompts.en: Audit this design: score it on 6 dimensions and list P0–P2 issues
quickPrompts.zh: 走查这份设计稿：给我 6 维评分和 P0–P2 问题清单
